title: Chapter 1 Unfamiliar Places
content:
Chapter 1 Unfamiliar Places

In the dark room, clothes and socks were thrown on the floor, and there was a rancid smell in the air.

In the only bright spot, a sloppy man was playing with a computer when a crackling voice came over,

"Fuck, it's so boring, I don't know what to play in the future!" Zhong Yu said.

The glorious New Romance of the Three Kingdoms XIII finally cleared the customs. The picture has been improved a lot, the city has also been added, and the hero's individual gameplay is also very interesting. It's just that there are too few cities. Even if you add some, it's only dozens of them. Compared with other Nobunaga series of Glorious, the number of cities is unknown, and the difficulty of unifying them is too low. It would be great if there were hundreds of cities, Zhong Yu muttered.

It seems that some great god heard the man's self-talk, but the man didn't notice that the icon belonging to the Three Kingdoms on the computer turned into a ray of light and shot at Zhong Yu's forehead. Then behind Zhong Yu, a black vortex appeared and the space around it seemed to be torn apart. Zhong Yu, who was confused, didn't react. What happened was sucked towards the back by a huge force. swirl.

The endless forest is full of greenery. From time to time, there are the sounds of insects and birds, and the howls of wild beasts, and in one of the clear creeks, there is a rustling sound. Just by the river, there was a moan, and looking around, it looked like a human body, lying by the river.

Zhong Yu opened his eyes with great effort, and there was a faint pain all over his body, but his somewhat confused mind was much clearer. Struggling to stand up and look around, I couldn't help feeling a little frightened. I saw forests that have not been polluted by modern industry all around, and a small stream next to it is crystal clear, and you can faintly see a few swimming fish swimming happily.

Where is this place? How am I in this place? Zhong Yu couldn't help but have these questions in his heart. I struggled to turn my brain, trying to recall what happened before, faintly, recalling that I seemed to be playing Three Kingdoms before, suddenly, a light shot out from the computer, and then I passed out, and then I woke up and I was here, what happened? What? What is that light? Why am I here? It's not like someone is joking with me. I'm just an otaku who doesn't go out of the gate, and doesn't have much money. Who would make such a joke with me? No one would be so stupid in kidnapping, targeting a target like me.

He shook his head vigorously, but calmed down and thought about his current situation.

Looking at the surrounding environment, it does not look like China. There is no pollution in this kind of place. There is no trace of human beings. It has long disappeared in China. It seems that the person who does not have such great ability, and the person who has the ability will not deal with such a small person as himself, Zhong Yu has a faint guess in his heart.

But now is not the time to think about these questions, but to walk around, see if there are any people, and ask yourself where you are.

Walk slowly along the river, next to the woods, walk along the river, you should be able to walk out of the forest.

On the road, we constantly shuttle in the forest, enjoying the beautiful scenery by the river. In modern times, we can't see such a beautiful scenery. Only through special synthesis and beautification on TV can we see it, but that is all on TV. Arrived, artificially synthesized, a bit false? It is a blessing to be able to see it for yourself!

The breath of nature entered Zhong Yu's heart, which made him feel a lot more comfortable when he was inexplicably brought here.

Walking happily, Zhong Yu couldn't help humming a few tunes, which seemed quite a bit like a leisurely rural life.

However, inexplicable thoughts kept flashing in Zhong Yu's heart, as if trying to think about the reason why he was here, his brows slowly wrinkled. Did you pass through? Have you never heard of such a place on Earth?

Just when Zhong Yu was thinking about it, a wolf howl came from his ear, and his whole body trembled. He looked back and saw a half-human-high wild wolf, looking at him with green and faint eyes, and couldn't help feeling a little bit. Soft feet.

However, his desire for life finally overcame his fear of wolves, and he ran forward with his legs flying, and the wild wolf followed quickly. He also caught up, only ten steps, five steps, three steps, one step away from Zhong Yu. After catching up, the fear and powerlessness in his heart burst out, and his whole body was shaking.

The sharp wolf claws slashed across his body, and the short sleeves that Zhong Yu bought for dozens of dollars could not effectively block the wolf claws. He immediately grabbed a few bloodstains, and a large piece of meat was torn off, dripping with blood. fell down.

The pain, the uncontrollable pain in his body, finally couldn't help but howl loudly. Zhong Yu felt the urge to stop and roll, but he knew that he couldn't stop now, and if he stopped, he would die.

Zhong Yu shifted his attention, constantly cursing the wolf in his mouth, cursing it viciously in his heart, but his feet didn't stop, he ran forward quickly, rolled a few times, and avoided the wolf's pounce. And there was a trace of brutal abuse in the eyes of the wolf behind. Seeing the prey in front of him running around in a hurry, he couldn't help being a little playful. More pleasure, but better appetite for yourself.

At this moment, Zhong Yu's mind was confused, and the pain in his body constantly reminded him that the danger behind him was approaching. If he didn't come up with a solution quickly, he might die at any time. what do I do? How can I save myself?

Suddenly, seeing a cliff in front of you, is there no way to go? Am I going to be eaten by this beast? Zhong Yu was wandering on the edge of the cliff, and his scattered eyes glanced at the edge of the cliff. Suddenly, there was a green field in front of him, and there was a tree trunk below. Is there any help? Zhong Yu suddenly thought of a way to save himself.

The wolf slowly pushed up and pushed Zhong Yu to the edge of the cliff. Watching Zhong Yu constantly walking on the edge of the cliff, he seemed to want to find a way to survive. There was a flash of excitement in the wolf's eyes, watching the prey anxiously looking for a way to survive, only to find that he had only one way to die. That feeling made the wolf's whole body tremble with excitement, and the wolf's hair stood up.

"You bastard, even if I fall to my death and fall off a cliff, it won't hurt your stomach." Zhong Yu said fiercely to the wolf in front of him.

The wolf in front of him seemed to understand Zhong Yu's provocation. Annoyance flashed in the wolf's eyes several times, and he quickly rushed towards Zhong Yu. Zhong Yu immediately ran forward and jumped off the cliff.

When the wolf saw that Zhong Yu seemed to want to jump off the cliff, he immediately accelerated his speed not to go, fast, he was getting close to that hateful human being, and he was about to tear it apart and swallow it into his stomach.

Just one step, just one step, Zhong Yu jumped off the cliff ahead of time, grabbed the trunk tightly, and survived, I finally survived.

The wolf couldn't stop and jumped down, but he was not so lucky. His four claws couldn't catch the tree trunk. The two front wolf claws caught deep claw marks on the tree trunk. The two hind legs were kicking haphazardly below.

Hanging in the air like this, full of fear, Zhong Yu saw the ugly face of the wolf's fear, and the thrill of revenge flashed in his heart several times, making you want to eat me, now you are going to die, I will not let you go .

Zhong Yu slowly crawled over, stood on top of the wolf's head, his feet slowly moved towards the wolf's front paws, the wolf's eyes were full of fear, as if he knew what was going to happen next, his mouth flashed. A few whines, as if begging himself not to step on it.

Zhong Yu looked at the pleading in the wolf's eyes, and a few perverted pleasures flashed in his heart. He stepped on his feet like this, and fell off the cliff with a loud cry of the wolf, fell to his death, and fell into a piece of minced meat.
